name: Galilee
overview: Galilee, located in the northern district of Palestine, is biblically significant as a region encompassing cities of refuge such as Kedesh, as well as territories given to Hiram. The borders of Galilee are described in detail, extending to the Sea of Chinnereth (Sea of Galilee), which is also called the Sea of Tiberias or Lake of Gennesaret. Scripture highlights Galilee's role in God's providence, not only as a physical territory but as the setting for Jesus' residence, ministry, and post-resurrection appearances, emphasizing its importance in the unfolding of redemptive history.
